gaps.sentence: They can't help ___ at his impression of the boss.
gaps.explanation: can't help + -ing = can't stop yourself: can't help laughing.

gaps.sentence: They're planning ___ the flat before selling it.
gaps.explanation: plan + to-infinitive (plan on + -ing also occurs informally): planning to redecorate.

gaps.sentence: She admitted ___ the last train and had to take a taxi.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit doing' — confess to a past action takes the gerund.

gaps.sentence: Try ___ the handle — sometimes it sticks.
gaps.explanation: try + -ing = experiment with a method; try to do = make an effort.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ off the lights when you leave.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do a duty: forget to turn.

gaps.sentence: I could hear the neighbours ___ again last night.
gaps.explanation: hear + object + -ing = hear an action in progress: hear them arguing.

gaps.sentence: When I was a student, I used ___ in shared flats.
gaps.explanation: used TO + infinitive = past habit/state: used to live. (Compare: be used to living.)

gaps.sentence: She's considering ___ the flat and moving to the coast.
